test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, "ABUSE" is written as "DEXVH" and "CANDY" is written as "FDQGB". How will "DESERT" be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8943515a4d9fcecd3da6d91b0103980721287b5db10632c38142f26206ee020b.png] 

**Logic: **Addition of (3) in all letter's position values.

'ABUSE' is written as 'DEXVH' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b3bc1718d6f6847a383e4f035e3c6ef7575976399fdfcda131ac967a4a1a111.png] 

'CANDY' is written as 'FDQGB' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96e5ada705dfcc23f22e43bd653009cdca5a81d711d228792e31fa28c7b57773.png] 

Similarly, 'DESERT' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a41353736e212269a48bd13d38bea6d8d81f7fbacebe4297292240fa1570be93.png] 

Here, 'DESERT' is written as** 'GHVHUW'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
